ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Secure Deletion with SDelete
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects files that have extensions commonly seen while SDelete is used to wipe files. Note: Unmapped fields: ObjectName

sequences.query: ((event_id = 4656 OR event_id = 4663 OR event_id = 4658) AND (ObjectName = RGX("\\\.AAA$") OR ObjectName = RGX("\\\.ZZZ$")))
